extraction: MCP Server Concepts: Programs exposing capabilities via standardized protocol. Examples: file system, database, GitHub, Slack, calendar servers. Three building blocks: Resources (document access, data queries - resource pickers with preview, smart suggestions, bulk selection), Prompts (reusable parameterized templates for domain, showcase best usage), Tools (executable functions). Multi-server power: combining specialized capabilities through unified interface. Example: travel planner with weather, booking, calendar servers. AI executes prompt using tools from connected servers.
